sequences.actingRequirement: Force an opponent to discard a card.

sequences.name: Unwinged Angel
sequences.ability: Danger Sense: Shield your Hand & Pouch from the next attack this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Cancel an attack or take 0 hits this round.

sequences.name: Serial Killer
sequences.ability: Blood Trail: Destroy 1 Pouch card from target opponent (2 if they have ≤4 Hand cards).
sequences.actingRequirement: Target an opponent with 4 or fewer Hand cards.

sequences.name: Devil
sequences.ability: Desire: Steal 1 random Hand card from target opponent (or destroy 1 Pouch card if empty).
sequences.actingRequirement: Steal a card or destroy a Pouch card via Desire.

sequences.name: Desire Apostle
sequences.ability: Temptation: Every opponent with more cards than you discards 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Trigger Temptation on an opponent.

sequences.name: Demon
sequences.ability: Abyssal Filth: Every opponent holding >5 Hand cards discards down to 5 immediately.
sequences.actingRequirement: Force an opponent to discard via Abyssal Filth.

sequences.name: Blatherer
sequences.ability: Demonic Ravings: Target opponent discards 2 random cards from Hand!
sequences.actingRequirement: Reduce an opponent to ≤2 Hand cards or skip.

sequences.name: Bloody Archduke
sequences.ability: Massacre: Discard 1 Hand card to destroy 1 Pouch card from every opponent with ≤5 Hand.
sequences.actingRequirement: Destroy a Pouch card from a low-hand opponent.

sequences.name: Filthy Monarch
sequences.ability: Corruption: Target opponent discards 2 cards; if they hit 0 cards, you draw 2 & tuck 1!
sequences.actingRequirement: Force an opponent to lose a turn or ≤1 Hand.

playstyle: Alchemy & artifacts: subtracts Pouch math, forges Face Cards into table Artifacts, and transmutes Suits.
chaosDesc: Destroy the center Trump Card and replace it with the top card in the Grave.

sequences.name: Savant
sequences.ability: Precision Math: You may SUBTRACT Pouch card values when ascending this turn (e.g. 9-1=8).
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a Pentacle or hold 2+ Pouch cards.

sequences.name: Archaeologist
sequences.ability: Excavate: Look at bottom 3 cards of Deck and draw 1 into Hand.
sequences.actingRequirement: Draw or excavate a card from the Deck.

sequences.name: Appraiser
sequences.ability: Appraise: Draw 1 card (2 if you hold a Face Card in Hand).
sequences.actingRequirement: Hold or reveal a Face Card during the round.

sequences.name: Artisan
sequences.ability: Forge Artifact: Gain +2 trick value this round (max 9) and draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Activate Forge Artifact during a trick.

sequences.name: Astronomer
sequences.ability: Star Alignment: Your 10s count as Aces, and your Aces count as any Number (1–9) in Pouch!
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a 10/Ace or tuck one in Pouch.

sequences.name: Alchemist
sequences.ability: Transmute: Your next played trick card counts as the Trump Suit!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick using a transmuted card.

sequences.name: Arcane Scholar
sequences.ability: Sealed Armory: Pull any Face Card from the Grave into your Hand (else draw 1).
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a Face Card during the round.

sequences.name: Knowledge Moor
sequences.ability: Master Blueprint: Your Kings can win tricks (value 10) AND reveal/steal!
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a King or win a trick with +2.

sequences.name: Illuminator
sequences.ability: Civilization's Light: You may Ascend using cards directly from your Hand this turn!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick with a Face Card, 10, or Ace.

playstyle: Concealment: excels playing last, puts rival Hand/Pouch cards to "Sleep," and conceals plays face-down.
chaosDesc: Secretly inspect target opponent's Pouch and draw 1 card from the Deck.

sequences.name: Sleepless
sequences.ability: Night Owl: Draw 1 card from the Deck (+1 trick value if playing last).
sequences.actingRequirement: Play last in a trick or use Night Owl.

sequences.name: Midnight Poet
sequences.ability: Lullaby: Put target opponent's highest card to sleep (they discard 1, draw 1).
sequences.actingRequirement: Trigger Lullaby or draft a card.

sequences.name: Nightmare
sequences.ability: Pull into Dream: Force target opponent to discard 1 random card from Hand.
sequences.actingRequirement: Disrupt an opponent's Hand.

sequences.name: Soul Assurer
sequences.ability: Requiem: Cancel all Sword & Wand actions targeting you this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Complete a trick taking 0 Sword/Wand hits.

sequences.name: Spirit Warlock
sequences.ability: Concealment: Conceal your Pouch—immune to Swords, peeks & swaps this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Keep your Pouch untouched for a round.

sequences.name: Nightwatcher
sequences.ability: Horror Aura: Gain +2 trick value and reverse turn priority for ties.
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick with Horror Aura.

sequences.name: Horror Bishop
sequences.ability: Sleep of Concealment: Lock target opponent from Ascending this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Lock an opponent's Pouch for a round.

sequences.name: Servant of Concealment
sequences.ability: Erase Presence: Your next played trick card ignores Leading Suit and counts as Trump!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick with a concealed card.

sequences.name: Knight of Misfortune
sequences.ability: Eternal Night: Every opponent discards 1 card; if you win the trick, draw 2!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick while Eternal Night is active.

playstyle: Fluid alchemy: swaps freely between Hand/Pouch/Grave, turns Cups into Trump cards, and steals with Swords.
chaosDesc: Shuffle all face-down cards from every player's Pouch together and deal back equally.

sequences.name: Apothecary
sequences.ability: Herbalism: Swap 1 card in your Hand with 1 card in your Pouch.
sequences.actingRequirement: Swap a card between Hand and Pouch.

sequences.name: Beast Tamer
sequences.ability: Familiar: Draw 1 card from top of Grave (or Deck if Grave empty).
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a Cup during a trick.

sequences.name: Vampire
sequences.ability: Blood Drain: Steal 1 face-down card from target opponent's Pouch into your Hand.
sequences.actingRequirement: Steal a card from an opponent's Pouch.

sequences.name: Potions Professor
sequences.ability: Brew Elixir: Tuck 1 extra card from Hand into your Pouch immediately (up to 3).
sequences.actingRequirement: Add 2 cards to your Pouch in one round.

sequences.name: Scarlet Scholar
sequences.ability: Full Moon: Your Cups count as the Trump Suit this trick!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick using a Cup card.

sequences.name: Shaman King
sequences.ability: Moonlight Swap: Swap 1 card in your Pouch with the top card of the Grave.
sequences.actingRequirement: Swap a card between Grave and Pouch.

sequences.name: High Summoner
sequences.ability: Summon Spirit: Pull 1 Knight or Queen from Grave into Hand (else draw 2).
sequences.actingRequirement: Pull a Face Card from Grave or play one.

sequences.name: Life-Giver
sequences.ability: Vitality: Draw 2 cards from the Deck (3 if you have ≤3 Hand cards).
sequences.actingRequirement: End a round with 6+ cards in Hand.

sequences.name: Beauty Goddess
sequences.ability: Crimson Moon: Steal 1 Pouch card from target opponent and draw 1 from Deck.
sequences.actingRequirement: Swap/steal from an opponent's Pouch & win trick.

playstyle: Radiant control: refills hands via mutual pacts, purifies traps/Chaos Events, and boosts Cups and Pentacles.
chaosDesc: Draw 1 card from the Deck, and immediately tuck 1 extra card into your Pouch.

sequences.name: Bard
sequences.ability: Inspire: You and target opponent each draw 1 card from the Deck.
sequences.actingRequirement: Cause yourself and an opponent to draw in one turn.

sequences.name: Light Suppliant
sequences.ability: Flash of Light: Reveal top of Deck—draw it (+1 more if it is a Cup or Pentacle).
sequences.actingRequirement: Play or reveal a Cup or Pentacle.

sequences.name: Solar High Priest
sequences.ability: Purify: Shield yourself from traps/debuffs this round and draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a Cup or Pentacle taking 0 hits.

sequences.name: Notary
sequences.ability: Notarized Pact: Swap 1 card with target opponent; both of you draw 1 extra card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Complete a trade or draw via Notary.

sequences.name: Priest of Light
sequences.ability: Sun's Protection: Your Hand cannot drop below 3 cards this round; draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: End a round with 4+ cards in Hand.

sequences.name: Unshadowed
sequences.ability: Unshadowed Spear: Destroy 1 Pouch card from target opponent (ignores Page Traps!).
sequences.actingRequirement: Destroy an opponent's Pouch card.

sequences.name: Justice Mentor
sequences.ability: Radiant Law: Clear negative locks on you and every player draws 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a trick with Radiant Law active.

sequences.name: Lightseeker
sequences.ability: Blazing Sun: Your Cups & Pentacles gain +3 trick value (max 9) this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick with a Cup or Pentacle.

sequences.name: White Angel
sequences.ability: Purification Halo: Draw 2 cards and clear all opponent round buffs.
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick holding 5+ Hand cards.

playstyle: Strict order: declares Forbidden Suits/Face Cards/Abilities, taxes rule-breakers, and enforces raw number tricks.
chaosDesc: Every opponent with cards in their Pouch must return 1 random Pouch card to their Hand.

sequences.name: Arbiter
sequences.ability: Authority: Gain +1 trick value; draw 1 card if you play Trump Suit this trick.
sequences.actingRequirement: Play the Leading Suit or Trump Suit.

sequences.name: Sheriff
sequences.ability: Track: Peek at target opponent's Hand and draw 1 card from Deck.
sequences.actingRequirement: Draft a card or track an opponent.

sequences.name: Interrogator
sequences.ability: Psychic Piercing: Force target opponent to discard 1 card (if they have Trump Suit, they lose 2).
sequences.actingRequirement: Force a discard via Interrogator.

sequences.name: Judge
sequences.ability: Prohibition: Forbid Swords this trick—anyone playing a Sword gives you 1 Hand card!
sequences.actingRequirement: Enforce a Prohibition during the trick.

sequences.name: Disciplinary Paladin
sequences.ability: Punishment: Forbid 10-overrides and Face Cards for opponents this round.
sequences.actingRequirement: Enforce Punishment for a round.

sequences.name: Imperative Mage
sequences.ability: Deprivation: Disable target opponent's Sequence Ability for this round and draw 1.
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick while an opponent is deprived.

sequences.name: Chaos Hunter
sequences.ability: Order Restored: Cancel Trump overrides and draw 1 card from Deck.
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick without Trump overrides.

sequences.name: Balancer
sequences.ability: Balance of Power: Every opponent with more Hand cards than you discards down to match (max 2).
sequences.actingRequirement: End a round tied for or holding most Hand cards.

sequences.name: Hand of Order
sequences.ability: Supreme Verdict: Cancel Trump Suit & 10s this trick, and gain +2 trick value!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick under Supreme Verdict.

playstyle: Patient cultivation: grows Pouch card values over time, mutates Ascension Math, and shields a full Pouch.
chaosDesc: Immediately end the trick boost—gain +3 trick value (max 10) to seize the trick right now.

sequences.name: Planter
sequences.ability: Sow: Cultivate your Pouch—all your Pouch cards gain +1 leeway for Ascension Math!
sequences.actingRequirement: Keep a card in your Pouch for a full round.

sequences.name: Doctor
sequences.ability: Heal: Recover the top card of the Grave into your Hand and shield Hand once.
sequences.actingRequirement: Play a Cup or recover a card from Grave.

sequences.name: Harvest Priest
sequences.ability: Bountiful Harvest: Draw 2 cards if your Pouch has 3 cards (else draw 1).
sequences.actingRequirement: Start or end a turn with 3 Pouch cards.

sequences.name: Biologist
sequences.ability: Crossbreed: Discard 1 Hand card to give your played trick card +3 value (max 9).
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick using a boosted card.

sequences.name: Druid
sequences.ability: Life's Shield: Shield your Hand from Wands/Kings this round and draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Block a Wand/King or play a Pentacle.

sequences.name: Classical Alchemist
sequences.ability: Mutate: Adjust your Pouch Ascension sum by ±2 this turn and draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Hold 2+ Pouch cards and trigger Mutate.

sequences.name: Pallbearer
sequences.ability: Cycle of Life: Move the top Minor Arcana from Grave directly into your Pouch.
sequences.actingRequirement: Pull a card from Grave into Hand or Pouch.

sequences.name: Desolate Matriarch
sequences.ability: Overgrowth: Tuck 1 extra card from Hand into Pouch immediately and draw 1 card.
sequences.actingRequirement: Fill your Pouch to 3 cards in a turn.

sequences.name: Naturewalker
sequences.ability: World Tree: Pouch is completely immune this round AND gains ±2 Ascension leeway!
sequences.actingRequirement: Win a trick while holding 3 Pouch cards.
